_meta.notes: World simulation config per DESIGN.md Part 13.6, 13.7, 13.9

max_players_per_world.description: Design target for max players per world

persistence_enabled.description: Keep a disconnected plant for the reconnect window and restore it on reclaim. Off by default in local/dev: a reload or restart creates a fresh plant (ADR-029).

cell_size.description: Spatial cell size in world units

interest_ring_radius.description: Number of cell rings to subscribe to

per_client_entity_cap.description: Max entities sent to a client per tick

snapshot_interval_ticks.description: Ticks between binary snapshots (default 5 min at 20 Hz)

dormant_step_interval_sec.description: Dormant tier step interval in seconds

tick_budget_active_share.description: Max share of tick budget for Active tier

tick_budget_warn_threshold_ms.description: Warn when Active tier exceeds this ms per tick

interest_detail_distances.description: InterestManager detail level distances in world units

max_frame_time_ms.description: Maximum frame time in ms for tick clock (prevents spiral of death)
